title: Relations with Parliament — measured pilot

ownership.note: Directory host association plus observed trusted redirect and institutional identity. Legacy portfolio titles in directories may differ; no endorsement implied.

conditions: Sequential Lighthouse 13.5.0 / Chrome 153 laboratory runs, up to three declared attempts per each of 3 predeclared pages on mobile and desktop; default simulated throttling and fresh browser processes. Per-pair successful-run counts and any unattempted runs are explicit; a collection stop is not a website failure. Operator network/geography unverified. Guarded DOM/axe observations use GET/HEAD and four-request concurrency; excluded requests can change rendering. No forms submitted, physical devices, field INP, full security audit, complete service process or 28-day reliability claim. Independent review pending. Different page samples are not a national comparison.
collectionNotes: 18 timing attempts recorded of 18 planned; 0 unattempted after collection limits.
3 distinct predeclared core page(s), with three attempts per page/device. Missing roles and narrower samples are not equivalent to complete website coverage.
homepage: guarded observation gaps retained; normal-browser follow-up is separate.
institution: guarded observation gaps retained; normal-browser follow-up is separate.
The legislative-tracking capture shows session headings and archive entry points; its downstream records and downloads were not opened, so service/document functionality remains unmeasured.
No legal accuracy, successful search, keyboard completion or full WCAG claim is made.

Completion review 2026-10-26 of the 21 October follow-up: 3 previously unmeasured criteria resolved, adding 3 assessed budget points. 3/3 additional core-page follow-ups were representative; excluded captures and original attempts are retained. Prior valid timing samples are unchanged. 36 criteria remain unmeasured; see the completion record for required evidence.

Supplementary GET search tasks, where present, use observed search forms and do not expand the original Lighthouse timing sample. Retained visual comparison is explicitly distinguished from fresh capture. Collector connection failures, robots exclusions and incomplete responses are never website zeros.

Coverage revision 2026-10-28: 1 further criteria resolved using explicit reviewed evidence. Restricted, untested and monitoring-dependent criteria remain unmeasured. Scores and measurement coverage are different quantities; no conversion of missing evidence to passes or zeros.

findings.title: Mobile homepage loading
findings.detail: Median lab LCP 11.47 seconds, range 11.40–11.49 seconds across three successful simulated runs. This operator-network result is not a field percentile or every visitor's experience.

findings.title: Different pages share a generic document title
findings.detail: Responsibilities and legislative tracking have distinct visible headings, but the captured document title is identical and meta descriptions are absent.

findings.title: Small horizontal overflow needs responsive review
findings.detail: Normal-browser captures record 12 pixels of document overflow at 320, 390 and 844 pixels. The reviewed 390-pixel responsibilities screenshot still shows readable content; complete mobile task success is not inferred.

categories.label: External Security Posture and Technical Privacy

rows.label: HTTPS enforced
rows.reason: The declared HTTP entry upgraded to trusted HTTPS without an observed downgrade. Credit is limited to this captured entry chain.

rows.label: Valid TLS certificate
rows.reason: Normal hostname/chain/date-verified HTTPS succeeded on every declared core page. This does not enumerate supported protocols or ciphers.

rows.label: Modern TLS configuration
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Full protocol/cipher assessment, not one negotiated connection. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: HSTS present and meaningful
rows.reason: Captured HSTS policies were parsed against the frozen rule: full requires max-age at least one year with includeSubDomains; a valid positive narrower policy earns half; absent, disabled or malformed earns zero. Worst declared page governs.

rows.label: Content-Security-Policy present and meaningful
rows.reason: Enforced CSP was absent from every successful captured response and all guarded DOM meta-policy inventories. Report-only policies, if any, do not enforce protection.

rows.label: Other important security headers
rows.reason: Reviewed nosniff, DENY/SAMEORIGIN or restrictive frame-ancestors, and explicit meaningful Referrer-Policy values. Full needs all three protections, half some, zero none; worst sampled page governs.

rows.label: Secure cookie configuration
rows.reason: Only attributes of observed cookies are reviewed. Full requires Secure, HttpOnly and explicit Lax/Strict on all; partial means mixed protections. No names/values or complete consent/tracking audit are published.

rows.label: No mixed HTTP/HTTPS content
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Browser and sampled-page evidence. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: No unnecessary software/version exposure
rows.reason: Reviewed the captured response Server/X-Powered-By fields and generator metadata on all three representative core documents. No software product/version disclosure was established in this specific header/metadata sample. Full criterion credit is sample-bounded and does not assert a modern, patched or vulnerability-free stack.

rows.label: No obvious sensitive configuration exposure
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Passive eligible-page review only; no guessed sensitive paths. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: Third-party tracking and technical privacy restraint
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Request inventory plus tracking classification. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.
